snippet.title: Pixel Washer – #PlayAcclaim | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2572060/Pixel_Washer/

Enter the serene world of Pixel Washer, a cozy, zen-like action-casual indie sim where you play as Pigxel, an adorable power-washing piggy. Clean dirty sprites across vibrant pixel art landscapes, upgrade your washer, uncover hidden secrets, and relax at your own pace.

What to Expect:

• Chill Power-Washing Gameplay – Satisfying, stress-free cleaning across charming pixel levels.
• Upgrade & Explore – Enhance your power washer and discover secrets hidden beneath the grime.
• Cozy & Relaxing Atmosphere – A game built for unwinding, perfect for players of all ages.
• Multi-Language Support – Interface, audio, and subtitles available in several languages.
• Indie Passion Project – Created by Valadria, delivering comfort and charm through playful design.

---
